_readme: CCM26 Realism Engine v1 tuning. Feature flags live in the environment (SIM_REALISM_ENABLED, SIM_REALISM_SHADOW_MODE, SIM_REALISM_REFERENCE_VERSION, SIM_REALISM_FORMATS, SIM_REALISM_BASELINE); everything numeric lives here. Defaults for anything omitted are in engine/realism/config.py DEFAULTS, and config/realism.local.json overlays this file for local experiments without a commit. See docs/realism_engine_v1.md.

integration._readme: downstream_gain and rating_curve.normaliser are MEASURED, not chosen. Re-measure in this order after any change to the kept layers or the reference data: python -m tools.compare_realism --calibrate-curve --n 120 ; then --calibrate-gain --n 120. Iterate each until the printed ratios are ~1.00.
